author: RocketRabbit
quote: An incredibly inflated price tag. A pile of bugs on par with the Cyberpunk launch. A weak story with uneven pacing. Where's the freedom of the previous installments? Some mechanics disappeared, but the hero's back sweat and the repair simulator got fine-tuned. Toxic relationships are in, but prostitutes got removed. Rockstar, bent over by the woke agenda, can troll animal rights activists and kill them, but LGBT characters? Oh no, that's forbidden! It's just blatant ass-kissing of the LGBT crowd and double standards. And a heap of **** for dropping physical discs and supporting Sony's policy. Should've just waited for the PC release with patched bugs and mods for ACTUAL equality, lol."
